strategic_assessment.headline: Week 1 closes with a rare artefact in hand and a clear activation path into Week 2
strategic_assessment.body: Friday close on Week 1. The SOUL.md / reasoning transparency angle is still warm and unused — the content window has not closed, but it will. The /reasoning screenshot is one of the most visually compelling AI artefacts Krish has produced and it has not been deployed anywhere yet. That is a Week 2 priority, not a Week 3 one. Enterprise AI trust is accelerating as a buying criterion: regulated industry buyers are now asking 'how does it decide?' before 'what does it do?' — Mindmaker and Meliora are positioned ahead of this curve if they move in the next 30 days. May KPI target: 4 strategic pivots from Layer 3 intel. Week 1 was setup and launch. Week 2 is execution. The pipeline is thin on raw signals — Zara needs a second capture source.
strategic_assessment.recommended_focus: Week 2 unlock: deploy the /reasoning screenshot as a cold outreach hook and a LinkedIn post before Wednesday. One action, two channels, maximum signal ROI from an asset already in hand.

external_signals.signal: Agatha's /reasoning command — a live window into an AI agent's internal monologue — is sitting unused as an outreach and content asset. The screenshot shows the agent reasoning in-character, referencing SOUL.md, and formulating replies in real-time. No competitor has anything like this.
external_signals.recommended_action: Deploy as cold email opening hook this week: 'Most AI tools hide how they think. Ours doesn't.' Ship before Wednesday or the window tightens further.

external_signals.signal: Enterprise AI procurement is entering a new phase: legal and compliance teams are now blocking purchases until vendors can demonstrate auditable reasoning trails. The question is no longer 'what can it do?' but 'how does it decide?' — a question Mindmaker can answer on demand.
external_signals.recommended_action: Reframe the Meliora pitch to lead with governance-readiness. SOUL.md is not just a personality file — it is a behavioral contract with an audit trail.

external_signals.signal: AI persona consistency is emerging as a trust signal in B2B sales — buyers who have been burned by unpredictable AI outputs are now asking for systems that behave reliably across every interaction. Persona-driven agents with defined behavioral constitutions are the answer the market does not yet know to ask for.
external_signals.recommended_action: Add a 'consistency guarantee' framing to Mindmaker BD decks and cold sequences. Position SOUL.md as the mechanism, not the feature.

external_signals.signal: Founders showing the machine — not just the output — are generating disproportionate organic reach on LinkedIn right now. Behind-the-scenes AI system design content is in a engagement category of its own. The /reasoning demo is exactly this content, and it has not been posted.
external_signals.recommended_action: Draft: 'I typed Huh? to my AI COO and then ran /reasoning to see what it actually thought. Here is its internal monologue word for word.' Post before Thursday. Tag no one. Let the screenshot do the work.

external_signals.signal: The SOUL.md framework — behavioral constitutions for AI agents rather than system prompts — is a concept with genuine novelty on the speaking and podcast circuit. The framing is accessible, the demo is visual, and the timing aligns with peak mainstream AI curiosity among non-technical founders.
external_signals.recommended_action: Nova to identify 2 AI-native / future-of-work podcasts and submit a pitch in Week 2 using the SOUL.md angle. Target shows with founder-heavy audiences, not pure tech audiences.

external_signals.signal: Zara's capture rate stands at 1 artefact against a target of 7+ per week. The quality of Marcus's synthesis is directly gated by input volume. A single Telegram screenshot is not enough surface area to generate genuine Layer 3 insight — the signal pipeline is the current bottleneck for May KPI execution.
external_signals.recommended_action: Flag to Agatha: expand Zara's capture sources in Week 2. Candidates: a Telegram forward channel for web finds, browser bookmark sync, and manual Layer 1 drops from Krish's daily browsing. Low effort, high leverage.
